not_for: Individuals who wish to remain entirely private
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: People with no social media accounts.

prerequisites.required: An existing professional background or creator niche.
prerequisites.recommended: An active LinkedIn or Twitter profile.

overview.positioning: Turn your expertise into authority and inbound opportunities.
overview.short_description: Learn to define your unique value, optimize your digital footprint, and create content that attracts clients, employers, and an audience.

key_facts.capstone: Complete a personal brand audit and a 30-day content rollout.

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Articulate your unique value proposition clearly.
Optimize your LinkedIn profile for search and conversion.
Network strategically to build high-value relationships.

why_now.industry_shift: People trust people more than faceless corporate brands.
why_now.ai_impact: AI makes content generation easy, making authentic personal voice the only true differentiator.
why_now.business_demand: Founders with strong personal brands lower customer acquisition costs.
why_now.career_opportunity: A strong personal brand acts as a 24/7 digital resume for premium opportunities.

learning_outcomes: DEFINE: Your niche and core messaging.
CREATE: A sustainable thought leadership content system.
MONETIZE: Leverage the brand for career or business growth.

stages.name: Positioning
stages.desc: Defining who you serve and how.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Relying purely on referrals for leads.
business_use_cases.approach: Build a LinkedIn presence sharing case studies and frameworks.

ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Personal stories, unique insights, and authenticity.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Ensure AI text doesn't sound robotic or use cliché phrases.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Do not use AI to write generic 'hustle culture' posts.

best_practices: Optimize your profile headline for the job/client you want.
Post consistently (3x a week) with high-value insights.
Engage with others' content for 30 minutes before posting.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Old habits from traditional job hunting.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Treat the profile like a landing page focused on how you help others.

career_paths.employer_expectations: A strong digital presence and clear communication skills.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A polished profile and a portfolio of thought leadership.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Interview client -> Revamp profile -> Write 1 month of posts.
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Examples of successful profile makeovers and viral posts.

assessment.criteria: Clarity of messaging, visual cohesion, and content quality.

certification.title: Certified Personal Brand Strategist
certification.criteria: Complete the profile makeover and 30-day content plan.
certification.verification: Review of the live LinkedIn profile.

not_covered: Complex PR campaigns, traditional media training.

faq.question: Do I need to be an expert to build a brand?
faq.answer: No. You can build a brand by documenting your learning journey and sharing what you discover along the way.

faq.question: Is this just for LinkedIn?
faq.answer: While we focus heavily on LinkedIn due to its organic reach, the strategic principles apply to Twitter, Instagram, or a personal newsletter.

modules.module_purpose: Define your brand identity and optimize your digital storefront.
what_you_will_learn: Writing a compelling headline and bio

lessons.what_is_taught: The intersection of skills, passion, and market needs.
lessons.why_it_matters: If you try to appeal to everyone, you appeal to no one.

lessons.what_is_taught: Optimizing the Banner, Profile Picture, Headline, and About section.
lessons.why_it_matters: Converts profile views into followers or leads.

lessons.what_is_taught: Creating a professional banner and selecting brand colors.
lessons.what_learner_does: Designs a LinkedIn banner in Canva.

modules.assignment: Submit the URL of the updated LinkedIn profile.
modules.business_application: Optimizing executive profiles for a company.

modules.module_purpose: Create content that drives engagement and build a network.

lessons.what_is_taught: Developing 3-4 content pillars and setting a schedule.
lessons.why_it_matters: Ensures consistency without running out of ideas.

lessons.what_is_taught: Writing compelling hooks, formatting for readability, and sharing stories.
lessons.why_it_matters: Good formatting stops the scroll; good writing keeps them reading.

lessons.what_is_taught: How to leave valuable comments and send effective DMs.
lessons.why_it_matters: Engagement is the fastest way to grow a new account.
lessons.what_learner_does: Executes an engagement routine for one week.

modules.assignment: Submit links to 3 published posts and screenshot engagement metrics.
